fix: remove name from SKILL.md frontmatter for autocomplete

Claude Code has a bug (#17271) where plugin skills with a name
field in frontmatter don't appear in slash command autocomplete.
The directory name is used as fallback, which matches in all cases.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: add marketplace.json for plugin installation

The plugin marketplace add command requires a marketplace.json file
in .claude-plugin/. Without it, the command fails silently and
the plugin cannot be installed. Also simplifies README install
instructions to use explicit commands instead of natural language.

New skill that audits an existing LLM eval pipeline across six areas
(error analysis, evaluator design, judge validation, human review,
labeled data, pipeline hygiene) and produces a prioritized findings
report. Positioned as the entry point for users new to evals.

Bumps plugin version to 0.2.0.
